notes.title: General Updates and New Game In Early Prep
notes.content: [p][b]Updates and upcoming project.[/b][/p][p]A short update for [b]Tavern In The Woods[/b]. Sorry, I've mentioned this a couple times before, so won't mention again. But this game/interactive story has been purchased and played way more than I was expecting. I thought I may get a couple hundred downloads after a while and maybe a couple reviews.[/p][p]At the time of this post – it’s has almost 25,000 (free) purchases and numerous reviews. By no means a big amount compared to some games, but way more than I was expecting![/p][p]Since it was launched, I've also made several updates and improvements. Some updates (I would admit) should have been there to start with, for example a settings menu. But these updates and improvements have all been added and are live.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Tavern in the Woods - Story Enhancements:[/b][/p][p]There are a few minor tweaks I will make, or have made, but these haven’t been released as yet. These are very small and more related to menu settings.[/p][p]I am also considering adding some additional story enhancements. I have found as I played through recently that I wished there was more story. As noted in previous posts this is my first game on steam and I was learning elements of this as I went along. So I was not able to focus at times or just got sucked in by the dev work, without spending as much time on the story line as I would have liked.[/p][p]So, I am looking into further story enhancements to add more depth. These updates won't be anything too large, as I want to focus on my upcoming project(s) (see below). But where ever I can improve Tavern In the Woods – I will do so.[/p][p]I've written a post in a bit more detail about Tavern In the Woods and if you wish to read further please see the link below.[/p][p][url="https://www.motionforgepictures.com/musings-tavern-in-the-woods/" style="button"]Musings - Tavern In the Woods[/url][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Planning phase for next game: Museum Horror (Working title)[/b][/p][p]I have, since making this game, had in mind my next game with far greater depth in both gameplay and story line (it's not connected to Tavern In The Woods). To this end I have several ideas. All though will be a single player, story line driven experience.[/p][p]I have several ideas, but two stand out. One set in a museum. Another set in the wilderness of either a remote part Canada, Alaska or Scotland. Or possibly both locations. A museum and a wilderness.[/p][p]I'm working the story line and setting now. But this is very early stages and will not be ready for release for some time.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Museum Horror (Working Title) Email Subscriber Page:[/b][/p][p]This is a newsletter for an upcoming game/interactive fiction.[/p][p]If you wish to stay updated on the work in progress, release of a demo and a release date please subscribe to the newsletter (see below).[/p][p]This newsletter is only for updates in relation to this game. It will also not send out regular updates, so do not worry about getting lots of newsletter updates.[/p][p]Below is a screen shot of the first mood board for the game. Presently the story line, setting, functionality is being planned and no dev or 3D environment work has started (you can see a larger version in the blog post).[/p][p][url="https://www.motionforgepictures.com/upcoming-game-museum-horror-working-title-newsletter/" style="button"]Link to Newsletter Page[/url][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595412/92eb21718cd8ad645c4538f557d09bfa8c9c4ae8.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Version 1.4 - Refinements and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Version 1.4 Released:

This refines and polishes the previous release and also updates the story game logic.

[b]Audio Settings:[/b]
1. The mono sound setting is fixed and the narration plays evenly over both speakers.
2. I've added a narration volume level setting to the audio settings.
3. I've also tweaked volume levels so the narration stands out further.

[b]Particle Effects:[/b]
4. I have further optimised particle settings.

[b]Refinements:[/b]
5. The longer notes now auto scroll (with a hint for the player to scroll) with no mouse cursor required. So you keep control of the viewport as well.
6. I have further amended game logic. So you now have to explore the [b]Tavern[/b] and [b]Barn[/b] before the goblin can appear.
7. The letter at the end still had one issue with some logic and didn't appear if you stood next to it - too soon. This is fixed.
8. I've added another sign post pointing in direction of barn and also changed the location of the map (in the tavern) so it's more prominent in the tavern.
9. Added the map also into the barn.
10. A few other tweaks and refinements.

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Additions:
Added narration.
Added achievements.
Added more information and details about the story and events unfoled.
Added a diary in the tavern about more info on the events that are happening.
Added a map in the tavern of the local area.
Improved story logic.

Game Logic:
Added logic so if you explore the landscape before entering the tavern you will not trigger any story events.
Added lock to the barn - so you have to find the key first.

General Refinements:
Added styled text to letters.
Added Letter paper background.
Toned down some particle effects - as they were too strong and also made them more performant.

Audio:
Add narration in game.
Added music to the menu.
Added more audio options.

Bug fixes:
Not really a bug - but fixed logic in the final letter that could keep it on screen.
A couple other minor bug fixes.

It has been purchased way more than I was expecting and after improvements to the options, settings and menus - I now have some updates to the story planned.[/p][p][/p][p]I am planning to add some additional elements to the story to provide some further info and also make the end of the story far more clear.[/p][p][/p][p]I am also looking into adding some achievements.[/p][p][/p][p]I am aiming to have this done by end of next week 20th of June. It's possible it may be a bit later, but if so I will provide further updates on the schedule.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Update 1.2:

[list]
[*] Overhauled the menu and settings graphics.
[*] Additional graphic settings. 
[*] Fps limiter or no limit at all. 
[*] Gamma control. 
[*] Master volume.
[*] Mouse sensitivity control.
[*] Other additional setting controls.
[*] Auto detection of resolution options your monitor provides. Although these can also be set manually.
[/list]

[b]Further Optimisations:[/b]

[list]
[*] Optimisation: Further optimised the package.
[*] Tweaked some settings and culling options.
[*] Optimised many textures.
[*] Reduced overall size of game by 700mb.
[/list]

[b]Other Updates:[/b]

[list]
[*] Corrected some typos.
[*] Updated Credits page.
[/list]

General Note:

This game/interactive fiction has had way more downloads than I was expecting. The number of downloads now stands at just over 16,000. I was expecting perhaps a few hundred at most and maybe a couple of reviews after a while! 

Thanks everyone that has downloaded the game, and the features I have added with this update, perhaps should have been there to start with! But are there now.

I am thinking of at least one further big update - but that will be in regards to the actual story line and making the ending clearer.

Motion Forge Discord: https://discord.gg/h2uZHa3ZQm

Thanks!
